oneLineSummary: Brown 1967 Pacific J. Math. canonical: Aut(S)=G2 x S3 with sigma (sign-reversal of doubling e8) + Psi (sqrt(3)/2 rotation in each (q, q*e) plane) generators. Wilmot 2025 (arXiv:2512.07210) CONTESTS S3 factor entirely — claims Aut(S)=G2 only via Theta-calibration argument.
rootCause: Over-permissive tests admit S6 (orbit-membership) or even S7/S8 (independent per-plane permutation). S3 acts COORDINATELY on 7 (q, q*e) planes simultaneously via 2pi/3 rotation — 'triality-like'.
recommendation: 256-check signed-permutation multiplication-table preservation gate (every basis pair (i,j) in 16x16): sigma(e_i * e_j) == sigma(e_i) * sigma(e_j) with sign tracking. Cross-check vs Wilmot's geoalg + GAP LOOPS loop-Aut bound.
caveats: OPEN dispute Aut(S)=G2 vs G2 x S3 (2025-2026, Wilmot calibration-Theta argument vs 50+ year citation chain). SYMPOSIUM should flag :CompetingVerdict, not pick side without user verdict.
